# libwasys.sys ![:inline](/images/twitter_verified.png) 

### Description

OPSWAT&#39;s libwasys.sys (OESIS V4 Helper Driver) exposes process termination through IOCTL 0x22E00C on \\.\WasysControl. Jehad Abudagga&#39;s KillerLand research publishes a proof of concept that submits a four-byte target PID and reports termination of protected AV/EDR processes. Static analysis of versions 10.3.85.0 and 10.3.2951.0 confirms that this IOCTL resolves the supplied PID with PsLookupProcessByProcessId, opens the process with ObOpenObjectByPointer using KernelMode, assigns it to a job object, and calls ZwTerminateJobObject. The device security descriptor grants generic-all access to built-in users. The shared README identifies version 10.3.85.0 by SHA256, while the bundled binary is version 10.3.2951.0; both samples contain the termination path. Protected-process termination is reported by the researcher and was not independently reproduced here.
- **UUID**: 0f50f568-bd09-4d8a-a73d-d37bdd0a1cb6
- **Created**: 2026-10-19
- **Author**: Michael Haag
- **Acknowledgement**: Jehad Abudagga | [@j3h4ck](https://twitter.com/@j3h4ck)

### Commands

```
sc.exe create libwasys binPath=C:\windows\temp\libwasys.sys type=kernel &amp;&amp; sc.exe start libwasys
```


| Use Case | Privileges | Operating System | 
|:---- | ---- | ---- |
| Terminate caller-selected processes from kernel mode to impair security tools. | Local user once the driver is loaded; administrator required to install the driver. | Windows |
